in_marathi.name: Omprakaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Possession of Prakriti (Nature)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omprakaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Omprakaan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Om' and 'Prakaash' which means 'to make visible' and 'nature' respectively. This name signifies the possession of Prakriti or nature. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is referred to as 'Prakriti Pradhana' which means 'the one who is the source of nature'. This name is believed to bestow the qualities of nature upon the bearer, such as strength, adaptability, and nurturing abilities.
